annotation_scheme.B-AC: The abbreviation token. The proposal specifies that an abbreviation is a single token.
annotation_scheme.B-LF: The first token of an explicitly stated long form.
annotation_scheme.I-LF: Every later token in that long form.
annotation_scheme.B-O: Any token that is neither an abbreviation nor part of a long form.
annotation_scheme.undefined_abbreviations: Label the short form B-AC; leave long_form null and do not infer an expansion.

excluded: ordinary clipped forms such as app and config
scope_rules.source_policy: A long form is populated only when it is stated or clearly paired with the abbreviation in one of the supplied papers. Otherwise it is null.
scope_rules.ambiguous_forms: Keep the abbreviation for detection; do not assign a guessed long form. The same short form may have different meanings in different documents.

training_guidance.important: This file is a lexicon of abbreviation forms found in the four papers, not a complete supervised training corpus. Train the token classifier on sentence-level examples annotated with the BIO-style labels above.
training_guidance.recommended_split: Split by paper, not by random sentence, so sentences from one source document do not leak across train and development sets.
suggested_use: Use entries with explicit long forms as weak supervision or annotation assistance.
Use entries with null long_form as abbreviation-detection examples only; never manufacture a definition.
Use observed_plural_forms and surface_variants to make sure plural and model-name variants are included in annotation.
Manually review every candidate before treating it as gold-standard training data, especially names appearing only in references or result tables.

coverage_note: This is a curated inventory of 85 CS-relevant abbreviation candidates identified in the four supplied papers, including their main text, tables, figures, captions, and selected related-work references. It is not a claim that every capitalized string or every acronym in the papers is included. Publication/organization names, measurement units, and mathematical symbols were filtered according to the proposal.
